where: Hushfrost Pass I & II (the frozen canyon route west) + the Aurora Hollow spur
mood: Lamp in the Canyon — a lone lamp in a frozen canyon, the cold at your back: sparse and tender enough to keep walking, hope holding on.
core_styles: F minor with suspended sus2 and sus4 chords
lone bell-like pulse-wave lead melody with long held notes and rests, a call answered by silence
very slow glassy suspended arpeggio, low in the mix
low tonic pedal bass, almost still
muffled heartbeat drum, a soft kick on beat one and a faint pulse after beat three
cold, sparse, lonely frozen canyon at night, a small warm lamp against the wind

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet cold entrance: wind-like noise breath, a low F pedal, then one lone bell note rings out and is answered by silence}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lone bell melody: a rising leap from C up to F that overshoots to G and hangs a beat too long, then settles stepwise A flat, G, F; heartbeat pulse beneath, wide space between phrases}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again, a soft warm string pad entering like lamplight underneath, a second quieter bell echoing the phrase endings}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: D flat major and E flat major, the only warmth on the road, a tender rising line toward a distant remembered warmth, then the cold closes back in}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lone bell theme returns, sparse again over the heartbeat; the last bar rises on a C pickup straight back into the theme, no ending}
